notes: Twelve macro groups are stable transform pivots for the authored heavy machine gun assemblies.
Every authored mesh receives a stable name, runtime ID, selectable flag, and destruction-group membership; relief patches are marked explodeWithParent.
Sockets, colliders, feed-cover/charging/bipod/ammunition-box interaction metadata, source-trace/projection metadata, and runtime summary counts are exposed under sculptRuntime/root.userData.
The audit validates the authored runtime contract statically; it does not claim a physics engine is installed.
